text: dsh-fullstack-team 是 DSH 的全流程研发团队插件，通过 bundle 注册 Agent Skill，并提供 devflow_gate 与 devflow_state 两个工具。插件包含 role-init 技能，用于依据项目标记装配角色并指引补充缺失能力；阶段门工具检查需求、设计、测试与验收文档并返回结构化发现；状态工具保存当前阶段、重做预算和历史，并在阶段门通过且预算未耗尽时推进流程。适合希望让 DSH 按阶段组织从需求到交付工作的用户。代码未显示必需 API 密钥或外部服务；项目需要在需求目录保存交付文档及 .dsh/devflow 状态文件。

dsh-fullstack-team adds a staged delivery workflow to DSH with role-init and two tools. devflow_gate checks stage documents and reports findings; devflow_state stores progress and rework budgets, advancing after a passing gate. No API key or external service is required by the read code.
想让 DSH 按需求、设计、开发、测试和验收阶段推进一个项目，并检查每阶段的交付文档是否齐全。
DSH 会话重开后，怎么继续追踪当前研发阶段和剩余返工次数？
I want DSH to validate project handoff documents at each delivery stage and keep workflow progress across sessions.
dsh-fullstack-team 的功能「阶段交付检查」：调用 devflow_gate 并指定阶段与需求目录，检查该阶段相关文档，返回是否通过及结构化发现。
dsh-fullstack-team 的功能「持久化流程状态」：调用 devflow_state 读取、推进、记录返工或重置流程；状态含阶段、各类重做计数和历史，推进会重新检查阶段门。

dsh-fullstack-team README · 全栈研发团队 · dsh-fullstack-team：**许愿式研发：说出你想要的，剩下的交给团队。**
**Wish-driven development: state the wish; the team ships it.**

dsh-fullstack-team README · 全栈研发团队 · dsh-fullstack-team：One [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle that carries a whole delivery — requirement to launch — not just the coding part. The flow has **six stages** (`clarify → design → build → test → accept → ship`; the closing work is folded into `ship`) and **four stage gates** (`clarify`, `design`, `test`, `accept`). **Review is an additional check inside `accept`**, not a seventh stage. Two deterministic tools turn "did anyone actually read that artifact?" from a model's good intention into a file check.

dsh-fullstack-team README · 全栈研发团队 · dsh-fullstack-team：You do not have to write code to use it: state what you want, and the flow splits the roles, walks the gates, and comes back with evidence. It stops and asks only when it is stuck, or when a decision belongs to you.

dsh-fullstack-team README · 全栈研发团队 · dsh-fullstack-team：The package ships **one** Agent Skill of its own — `role-init`, the entry every session gets — plus the flow's two tools. The nine capabilities the roles actually work with (`dev-orchestrator`, `requirement-clarify`, `acceptance-guard`, `ops-runbook`, `error-triage`, `impeccable`, `taste`, `ui-theme-governance`, `yunxiao-projex-ops`) are **not in this repository and do not ship with it**: they live in the separate `team-core` skill pack, provisioned at `~/.dsh/skill-packs/team-core`. See [Getting `team-core`](#getting-team-core) for how to obtain and verify it.

dsh-fullstack-team README · What's inside：| Part | Where | What it gives you |
|---|---|---|
| `role-init` | `skills/role-init/` (shipped) | 角色初始化与创造：识别技术栈、装配角色；缺能力时按「预置→已有→安装→检索→创造」逐级处置 |
| `devflow_gate` | tool, shipped | reads one stage's artifacts, returns typed findings; never writes, never decides |
| `devflow_state` | tool, shipped | durable stage, typed rework budgets, `advance`/`rework`/`reset` |
| 8 role manifests | `roles/*.role.yml` → generated `presets/roles.patch.yml` | `pm`, `backend-design`, `backend-java`, `frontend-vue`, `mobile-flutter`, `dsh-plugin-dev`, `qa`, `ops` |
| `team-core` | external pack, `~/.dsh/skill-packs/team-core` | the nine capabilities named above, one directory per skill |

dsh-fullstack-team README · What's inside：`role-init` is a **shared core**: one global bundle-patch entry broadcasts the shipped skills to every session, whether or not a preset lists them. Everything a role declares beyond that is a dependency — a skill pack — and packs are what the per-role allowlist can actually isolate. A pack is a directory of skills that only roles declaring it can see; a missing pack fails the role loudly with the directory it expected, instead of starting a role that silently lost half its kit.

dsh-fullstack-team README · What's inside：```yaml
packs:
  - name: team-core
    dir: ~/.dsh/skill-packs/team-core
```

`install` does everything: detects the host version, aligns the preset template with the shipped
`standard` preset, generates the eight role presets, backs up and merges your profile, re-reads and
verifies it, restarts the host. Running it twice prints `已是最新，无需操作` and touches nothing.
`--no-restart` and `--dry-run` exist for debugging; `--force` skips the compatibility gate (not advised).

dsh-fullstack-team README · Getting `team-core`：`team-core` is a directory of skills, one subdirectory per skill, each with a `SKILL.md`. It is distributed separately from this bundle — it is not vendored here and it is not published on npm as part of this package — because capability is reusable while project facts are not.

1. Copy the `team-core` directory from an existing DSH installation, or unpack the pack archive your team keeps, into `~/.dsh/skill-packs/team-core`.
2. Verify it before starting a role:

```bash

Run it from the package root — it resolves `roles/` relative to itself. text:
dsh-fullstack-team README · Install：One command. It aligns the plugin with the installed host, regenerates and
merges the role presets, and restarts the host for you:

```bash
npx dsh-fullstack-team install        # or, from a checkout / unpacked package:
node scripts/install.mjs
```

dsh-fullstack-team README · Install：Run it after installing the bundle, and again after every host upgrade. It is
idempotent: when the profile already holds the presets this version would
generate, it writes nothing, backs nothing up, restarts nothing, and prints
`已是最新，无需操作`. A successful run ends with one sentence:

```
已装好：8 个预设 → 宿主已重启（0.2.2-rc.1）
```

dsh-fullstack-team README · What the command does：| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| 1. Probe | Finds the host app and reads its version out of `app.asar`; names the target profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` by default) and the plugin version. |
| 2. Align | Compares `templates/preset.template.yml` with the standard preset the host ships. On drift it **re-derives the template** from the shipped standard, re-runs the same compatibility check, and writes the template back only if that second check passes. Drift that cannot be healed stops the run before anything is touched. |
| 3. Generate | `roles/*.role.yml` → preset patch, using the same rules as `scripts/roles.mjs`. |
| 4. Merge | Backs the profile up to `<profile>.bak-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS`, splices in only the block this plugin owns, re-reads the file and verifies it (ids unique, registry row present, every line outside the block byte-identical). |
| 5. Restart | Quits and relaunches the macOS app, because a profile patch is only read at boot. |

dsh-fullstack-team README · What the command does：A failure prints which step failed, which backup was restored (if any), and what
to do next:

```
失败：宿主 0.2.3 的预置模板与插件不兼容，且无法自动对齐（persona row 里没有 prefix 行）
[DRIFT] persona: ...
  → profile 未改动。把上面的 [DRIFT] 报告交给维护者，或运行 node scripts/check-preset-compat.mjs 看完整报告。
```

Nothing is ever left half-merged: a failed write or a failed verification restores
the backup (or removes a profile the run created) before exiting non-zero.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Flags：| Flag | When to use it |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | See the plan — probe, alignment, which presets would be added or removed, where the backup would go — without writing, backing up or restarting. Also the way to run on a machine with no host. |
| `--no-restart` | Install but leave the app alone: CI, debugging, or when you are about to restart by hand anyway. |
| `--profile <name\|path>` | Target another profile: `--profile web` → `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, or an explicit file path. |
| `--source <file>` | Merge an already-generated patch instead of generating (triage). |
| `--force` | Merge even though the template and the host standard disagree. Only after reading `node scripts/check-preset-compat.mjs` and confirming the drift is harmless. |

dsh-fullstack-team README · Flags：Exit codes: `0` installed or already up to date; `1` failed (rolled back);
`2` bad arguments. A missing host is skipped (`[SKIP]`) only under `--dry-run`,
`CI`, or `DSH_ALLOW_MISSING_HOST=1` — otherwise it is a failure, because on a real
macOS machine it means the desktop app is not installed where the command looked.
`DSH_APP_ASAR` / `DSH_APP_PATH` point it at a non-standard install location.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Flags：The same command is available as `pnpm dsh:install` in a source checkout. The
name is `install` **as an argument**, not as an npm script called `install`,
because npm runs a script with that name automatically during `npm install`.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Manual triage (only when the one command fails)：The layers the command drives are still runnable one by one:

```bash
node scripts/check-preset-compat.mjs                 # what exactly drifted, and why
node scripts/roles.mjs --write                       # regenerate presets/roles.patch.yml
node scripts/install-presets.mjs --profile desktop   # merge only, no align/generate/restart
node scripts/install-presets.mjs --dry-run           # what the merge would change

text:
dsh-fullstack-team README · Installing the bundle itself：The install command above installs the *presets*. The bundle layer loads at
profile boot and goes through the host's **`plugin_manager`**, not through hand
edits of a profile file:

- `install_bundle` with `target` set to the **absolute directory** of this package. It performs the package installation and the bundle selection itself — do not reproduce those steps with shell commands.
- `list_bundles` / `list_plugins` afterwards to confirm `dsh-fullstack-team` is registered and enabled.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Installing the bundle itself：The bundle inserts exactly one plugin, `dsh-fullstack-team`, which advertises the shipped skills. The profile needs **no** skill-directory configuration: the plugin reads `skills/` next to its own `lib/`.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Development only: `dsh plugin add`：While iterating on this repository, point a throwaway profile at the checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-fullstack-team
```

`link:` is a development shortcut, not a distribution channel: it bypasses the package installation that `install_bundle` verifies, and it only works on the machine that holds the checkout.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Installing from git：1. **No `lib/`.** `lib/` is git-ignored and `main`/`exports` point at `lib/index.js`, so a bare git tree has no entry point. Build first (`pnpm install && pnpm build`) and install the built directory, or install from a packed tarball (`npm pack`).
2. **Peer dependencies are not auto-installed.** Four peers are non-optional — `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 3.18.5, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (the host's `^0.2.1-rc.5` line). Profiles run pnpm with `autoInstallPeers: false`, so pnpm fetches none of them; they must already resolve inside the target profile. A mismatch surfaces as an unresolved peer at load time, not as an install-time error.

dsh-fullstack-team README · What a release contains：The published package carries `lib/`, `scripts/`, `skills/`, `roles/`, `templates/`, `presets/`, `docs/`, `examples/`, `locale/`, `icon.svg` and `cordis.patch.yml`. It does **not** carry `src/` or `tests/`, so `pnpm test` and `pnpm check` only work in a source checkout. The package-root scripts do work from an installed copy: `node scripts/install.mjs` (the one command), plus `node scripts/roles.mjs`, `node scripts/skill-audit.mjs`, `node scripts/check-preset-compat.mjs` and `node scripts/install-presets.mjs` for manual triage.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: dsh-fullstack-team
  name: dsh-fullstack-team
  config:
    providerName: dsh-fullstack-team   # default; the generator writes this same value for every role

dsh-fullstack-team README · Configuration：`include` does two jobs: it visibly narrows **pack** skills to the listed names, and it is checked against everything the instance can advertise — a name no source provides fails the startup with the visible set, instead of mounting a role that is quietly missing a capability. It does **not** hide the bundle's own skills: those are the shared core broadcast by the global patch entry, and the registry merges by name, so a nearer scope can shadow a duplicate but cannot remove any other skill. Only pack skills are isolated per role.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Configuration：The top-level `include` is a literal allowlist: `*` is **not** a wildcard there and is reported as a missing skill. `*` means "the whole pack" only inside a pack's own `include:` (as `mobile-flutter` does for the Flutter pack).

Every shipped skill is advertised at the bundled rank (600), so a project-level or user-level skill with the same name still wins.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Two tools：- **`devflow_gate`** — reads the artifacts of one stage and returns typed findings: missing files, surviving `TODO`s, empty sections, endpoints that the design and the contract disagree on, functional points with no test case, acceptance gaps, review evidence that does not resolve. It never writes and never decides.
- **`devflow_state`** — the durable state at `<requirement>/.dsh/devflow/state.json`: current stage, rework counters, history. `advance` re-runs the current stage's gate and refuses to move while it fails or while the stage's budget is exhausted.
dsh-fullstack-team README · Two tools：See [`docs/003-tools.md`](docs/003-tools.md) for the finding codes, failure budgets, and the `devflow.config.json` keys.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Behaviour to expect：- **Six stages, four gates.**（六阶段、四道阶段门）`clarify → design → build → test → accept → ship`. `build` and `ship` carry state but have no gate; closing work belongs to `ship`.
- **Review is a check, not a gate.**（review 是 accept 内的附加检查）`review` is executed inside `accept`: the accept run is a composite of the acceptance gate and the review check. `devflow_gate` still accepts `stage: "review"` for a standalone early check, but `advance` out of `accept` runs the composite — skipping review is not a way to reach `ship`.
- **Six typed failure types**（6 个失败类型）, each with a budget counted **per stage**: `DESIGN_UNFEASIBLE`, `CONTRACT_GAP`, `CONTRACT_CONFLICT`, `IMPL_MISMATCH`, `TEST_FAIL`, `ACCEPT_P0`. Counters reset when the flow enters a new stage. When a counter reaches its budget, `advance` is refused in that stage even if the gate passes.
- **Evidence is `path:line`（`路径:行号`）.** A verdict must carry its evidence on the same line or the line immediately after, and the cited location must resolve to a regular file **inside** the requirement directory. `../../x:1` is rejected without being read.
- **Two artifacts became mandatory**: `test-repo

dsh-fullstack-team README · Roles：A role is a preset whose `dsh-fullstack-team` entry carries an `include` allowlist and the `packs` that back it, so the role only ever sees its own kit of pack skills (plus the shared core). [`examples/role-preset.patch.yml`](examples/role-preset.patch.yml) is a complete copyable preset; [`docs/002-role-presets.md`](docs/002-role-presets.md) has the suggested kits per role.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Roles：Roles are **data, not code**: `roles/*.role.yml` declares each role's skills, the repository markers that call for it, and the packs it depends on. `node scripts/roles.mjs --write` turns those manifests into `presets/roles.patch.yml` against the upstream standard preset, so an upstream upgrade is a regeneration rather than a merge. In an installed package the package directory is read-only, so `node scripts/roles.mjs --out <path>` writes the generated patch wherever the profile lives.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Roles：`npx dsh-fullstack-team install` (the [one command](#install)) runs the whole handoff for you. Underneath it, `scripts/install-presets.mjs` does the merge half: generate → back up the profile patch → splice only the block this tool owns → re-read and verify. It is idempotent, refuses duplicate entry ids or a lost `agent-preset-registry`, restores the backup on failure, and takes `--profile <name|path>` / `--dry-run` (`node scripts/install-presets.mjs --dry-run` previews, writing nothing). Use it directly only when triaging a failed one-command run.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Roles：A role can also **depend on a skill pack** that is provisioned separately — the Flutter engineer loads the Flutter pack, and nobody else does. A declared pack that is not installed is a startup error, not a role that quietly runs without the capability it was hired for. See [`examples/role-preset-flutter.patch.yml`](examples/role-preset-flutter.patch.yml) and [`docs/004-skill-packs.md`](docs/004-skill-packs.md).

dsh-fullstack-team README · Design：- [`docs/001-design.md`](docs/001-design.md) — the mechanism design: two failure classes (compliance loss vs capability ceiling), the state machine with rework edges, the four gate contracts plus the review check, the role set, and the environment/permission sections (marked *not implemented*; they depend on infrastructure that does not exist yet).
- [`docs/002-role-presets.md`](docs/002-role-presets.md) — how a role hard-binds skills, and why the bundle's own skills stay shared.
- [`docs/003-tools.md`](docs/003-tools.md) — `devflow_gate` / `devflow_state`: finding codes, stage contracts, budgets, configuration.
- [`docs/004-skill-packs.md`](docs/004-skill-packs.md) — a role's dependencies, and what a missing or colliding pack does.
- [`docs/005-skill-hygiene.md`](docs/005-skill-hygiene.md) — the audit that keeps project facts out of capability files.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Design：Three principles the design rests on:

1. **Rules need an observation point.** A rule with no artifact and no gate is a wish. Every step produces a file, and a gate reads it.
2. **Models produce, code adjudicates.** Shape is JSON Schema, semantics are pure gate functions; judgement stays with the main agent.
3. **Static parts, dynamic assembly.** Role presets and skills are fixed parts; a project manifest decides which parts a request assembles.

dsh-fullstack-team README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check                      # typecheck + tests + skills audit + preset compat + build (source checkout only)
pnpm audit:skills               # skills/ only; also runs inside pnpm check
pnpm dsh:install                # the one command: align + generate + merge + restart

Manual triage, when the one command fails:

dsh-fullstack-team README · Development：```bash
node scripts/check-preset-compat.mjs         # template vs the host's shipped standard preset (exit 1 on drift)
node scripts/roles.mjs --write               # regenerate presets/roles.patch.yml after a role edit
node scripts/install-presets.mjs --profile desktop   # merge only; --profile <name|path>, --dry-run
```
